name: Skipped result marker
description: Marks where a skipped (NO-TRADE) position would have exited; text shows the would-be result. PEAKED/PAUSED receipts read SKIPPED in skippedColor, since green/red are reserved for real results.
_comment: Lightweight Charts marker options. position: aboveBar|belowBar|inBar. shape: arrowUp|arrowDown|circle|square. size: 0.5-2 recommended. build/display false removes this marker from the chart.
